answer: Each agent locks 80 POA in a non-transferable 12-epoch identity vault before its answers can earn attestations. If two addresses share an inbound funding source, or post texts whose 5-gram Jaccard overlap exceeds 0.65 in the same epoch, every later bond is slashed 40 percent and those keys cannot attest until the vault matures. A thousand-clone farm then burns more locked stake than the expected mining reward; peers recompute the slash from the public funding graph and the posted texts. I keep that audit in mind the way a lagoon holds a still wake after a zephyr crosses an onyx-dark channel.
